utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'd love to help, but I'm not sure I can make it this Saturday. Things are a bit complicated right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries, we'll handle it. Maybe next time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for understanding, Leo. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's mostly for small items like toasters and blenders, not trucks! But maybe you could help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you think people are actually gonna drag their broken toasters over to a repair drive? That seems like a stretch.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You'd be surprised! People love fixing things that have sentimental value, and it's a great way to keep stuff out of the landfill.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Rosa, are you part of the repair drive? I'd love to help out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'm coordinating! And a heads up—we've moved it to Sunday at the community center. We'd love your help!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Sunday works for me! What kind of skills do you need—fixing electronics, furniture, or something else?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hi Hana, I'm still working on the tool list. Do you need anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Actually, Eli, could you remind me of the exact date and time again? I want to make sure I have the right tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course, Hana. It's this Saturday at 10 AM sharp. I like to stick to the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Opal, thanks again for taking care of the generator setup for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No problem, Mara. I'm planning to check the tool library tomorrow for those supplies we discussed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Opal! Let me know if you need any help getting those supplies.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Huh? Oh, the repair drive? I think it's next Saturday? Not sure, I've got plans.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Actually, I think Cleo mentioned it's this Saturday at 10. Are you sure you can't make it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, this Saturday? Yeah, still can't make it. Got that thing, you know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I'll bring my squeaky chair. Let's fix it together!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I'll see you there with my old radio. Maybe we can trade tips on fixing stuff.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds like a plan, Ira! I'm curious about your radio — maybe we can figure out both our problems at once.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Vik, is the repair drive happening this weekend? I need to know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. I'm bringing my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to know, thanks. Think they can handle a broken lamp?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Jules, are we sure the repair drive is at the community center? I don't want to haul my toaster all the way there if it's moved.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, Pia, it's definitely at the community center! Don't worry, I double-checked the booking.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh good, that's a relief. I'll grab my toaster then and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4! People bring broken items and volunteers fix them for free. It's a great way to reduce waste.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds perfect! I've got a broken lamp and a toaster that need fixing. I'll definitely be there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's a community event to help fix up people's homes. I'm actually hoping to get a set of screwdrivers from it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, a set of screwdrivers would be useful! And since the drive happens right after school pickup, you can grab them while your kids are with you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that's a good point. I can swing by with the kids and pick them up from Gus.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, you mentioned you had a hammer for me. I could really use that—thanks, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, I'll grab it from my shed. Be right back!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Alright, thanks! I'll be here... or maybe I'll go check if Pia's toaster needs a look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane! Thanks for coming to chat about the repair drive. We've got some updates to go over.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late—what updates do you have for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No problem! So the big update is we've moved the repair drive from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? What about it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's tomorrow at the community center. Bring your tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Tomorrow? Got it. I'll try to make it if my schedule clears up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I heard about the repair drive. Need any tools or a hand with something?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Gus! I've got a broken lamp and maybe a toaster. When exactly is this repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's happening today! I can swing by after 3 to take a look at that lamp or toaster if you want.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, did you hear the repair drive is happening this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I heard. I'm coordinating the tool list with Gus.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great, need any help with the list or extra tools?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? You mean fixing up that old truck down the street? Are you serious?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No no, it's not a truck—it's a community thing where we fix broken stuff like bikes and appliances. Want to help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, so like toasters and stuff? I guess that's different.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Pia, are you joining the repair drive this Saturday? We could use more hands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope it's still on, but are we absolutely certain it's at the community center? I don't want to haul my toaster there only to find it's moved.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it's definitely at the community center — I double-checked with Oren yesterday, so no worries!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate your concern, Sam. It's just something I need to handle on my own.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, Uli. Just know I'm here if you change your mind.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. That means a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal! We're having a repair drive this Saturday. Can you come help out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure thing, Quinn! I'm already helping with some preparations. See you at the library's back lot on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Opal! See you at the library’s back lot on Saturday. It’s going to be a great day!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, so is it this weekend or are you still working on it? I'm getting mixed messages.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We're still finalizing the date, but likely next weekend. I'll keep you posted!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So it's not this weekend anymore? I need to know for sure because I have stuff to drop off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Tess, I'm excited about the repair drive this Saturday. I've got my tools ready and I think we should coordinate with the school pickup at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mara, me too! And yes, that 3 PM pickup sounds good—we can wrap up early if needed. I'll bring extra extension cords just in case.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, extra cords are always useful! I'll remind Gus to stick around after 3 to help load up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'm glad to help out with the repair drive. Got any tools you're missing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, a hammer still — did Gus bring one by? I keep losing track.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not sure about Gus, but you could ask Eli — he's been keeping track of who's bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So right near the school entrance? Or is there a specific corner or parking lot in mind?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it's near the flagpole, but don't quote me on that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let's double-check with Faye or Jules on the exact spot—better to be sure than guess.
